title: Fathers and Sons
author: Ivan Turgenev
blurb: 19th-century Russian literature's continued insistence on blatant licentious pandering serves only to embarrass the whole visual novel medium. "Fathers and Sons"? More like "Father "Father Sergius"|Sergius and Sons"!
blurb2: 20 - 12 = 29 - 18 17 + 3 = 23 Authors and dubious age-math. Many such cases!
